name: Lord Nellick
description: A wealthy businessman of Selhoff whose body is taken by Rav and who is later found dead in his parlor.

timeline.summary: Jacob Hauken meets Lord Nellick and Detective Wicker in Selhoff to discuss a horde of geists killing the morally bankrupt across Nephalia.
timeline.quote: "Thank you for your punctuality, Mr. Hauken."

timeline.summary: Wicker questions Nellick about why geists would target him, and Jacob advises him to stay inside and get wards.
timeline.quote: "Stay inside, Lord Nellick, though I'm sure I don't have to tell you that nowadays.

timeline.summary: Wicker shakes Nellick's hand, goes still, and then hurriedly leads Jacob away, telling him to call her Eloise.
timeline.quote: "You can call me Eloise," she says

timeline.summary: Jacob visits Nellick, asks about Cyril Rav, feels possession begin and pushes the necro-alchemist out.
timeline.quote: "Have you ever possessed a geistmage before? I promise you won't like it."

timeline.summary: Rav, in Nellick's body, admits he hired Jacob, that the geistbomb misfired and that the mayor was a stolen body he discarded.
timeline.quote: "Of course. I would much rather my geistbomb succeed than fail.

timeline.summary: Eloise and Millicent go to Nellick's mansion and find two unconscious servants and Nellick's body but no Jacob.
timeline.quote: She finds two unconscious servants in the kitchen, and a body in the parlor: Lord Nellick.

relations.note: Rav possessed and wore Nellick's body.
relations.quote: "This is rather awkward for me, I admit," Rav says
